items.a: A platform connecting organizations and creative talent through project briefing, recruitment, collaboration and deliverable review, with a wider vision for AI-assisted media intelligence and measurement.
Companies can create projects, discover creators, invite candidates, review proposals, coordinate work and approve deliverables.
Creators can maintain professional profiles, browse projects, respond to invitations, submit proposals and work within project studios.

items.q: Is the AI media monitoring engine already available?
items.a: Not yet. The monitoring and intelligence engine is part of the product vision described on this page.
Ambassadors can coordinate creator teams and initiate projects.
SMIACT is designed with an international audience in mind.
